description_en: You can retrieve agent workload report data
description_zh: 获取座席工作量报表数据
name: CloudAgentWorkloadReport

parameters.help_en: Statistical method. Valid values: 0: hourly, 1: daily, 2: summary, 10: queue summary
parameters.help_zh:
统计方法；说明：
0：分时
1：分日
2：汇总
10：队列汇总
parameters.name: statistic_method

parameters.help_en: Report type. Valid values: 1: daily, 2: weekly, 3: monthly, 4: custom time range
parameters.help_zh: 说明：统计报表类型，1：日报表2：周报表3：月报表4：自定义时间
parameters.name: time_range_type

parameters.help_en: Start date of the statistics period. Format: yyyy-MM-dd
parameters.help_zh: 说明：统计日期的开始时间，格式：yyyy-MM-dd
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: End date of the statistics period. Format: yyyy-MM-dd
parameters.help_zh: 说明：统计日期的结束时间，格式：yyyy-MM-dd
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en: Agent IDs. Query workload statistics for specific agents by agent ID. Separate multiple agent IDs with commas (,). By default, query workload statistics for all agents under the account
parameters.help_zh: 座席号；说明：根据座席工号查询指定座席的工作量统计支持按照多个座席工号进行查询，多个座席工号之间使用英文逗号","分隔，默认查询账户下所有座席的工作量统计
parameters.name: cnos

parameters.help_en: Outbound call IDs. Query workload statistics for specific agents by outbound call ID. By default, query workload statistics for all agents under the account
parameters.help_zh: 说明：根据外呼编号查询指定座席的工作量统计,默认查询账户下所有座席的工作量统计
parameters.name: gnos

parameters.help_en: Query start position. Valid value: an integer greater than or equal to 0. Default value: 0
parameters.help_zh: 查询起始位置；取值：大于等于0，默认0
parameters.name: start

parameters.help_en: Number of entries to return. Maximum value: 1000. Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh: 查询条数；取值：最大不能超过1000，默认10
parameters.name: limit

Code.description_en: Status code. OK indicates a successful request. For other error codes, see the error code list
